subject: Rotation evidence template + approvals (KMS) — need alignment + publish deadline
body:
From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Rotation evidence template + approvals (KMS) — need alignment + publish deadline

Priya, Naomi —

We need to land the KMS rotation evidence template + “who signs off” guidance this week. This is coming up in (1) SOC2/ISO narratives, and (2) enterprise security reviews where they ask “show me what you’d hand an auditor after a rotation.”

Can you both confirm:
1) What is *minimum required evidence* we should standardize for quarterly/annual rotations (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)?
2) Approval/sign-off chain: who must sign pre-rotation vs post-rotation? (Security, SRE, Product? customer operator?)
3) Deadline: I want this published (Confluence + docs site) by end of week so Sales/SE can reference it.

I’ve attached the current draft template/checklist.

Attachments:
- KMS-Rotation-Evidence-Template-v0.3.docx (draft)
- KMS-Rotation-Evidence-Checklist-v0.3.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
CISO, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Rotation evidence template + approvals (KMS) — need alignment + publish deadline

Aisha —

From the customer side, the “minimum set” that keeps coming up:

Must-have evidence items (what prospects ask for / what SEs want to point to):
- Change ticket / change record ID + scoped description (what key(s), what environments)
- Approval record (named approvers, timestamp, what was approved)
- Rotation execution window (planned vs actual)
- Confirmation that new key version was created/enabled + old version status (not necessarily deleted)
- Cutover steps + verification checks (e.g., dual-read window start/end, health signals)
- Audit logs exported showing the key version change / cutover toggle change (they like “system generated” evidence)
- Post-rotation validation results (smoke test + error rate/latency unchanged; and “no decrypt mismatch” if applicable)
- Rollback criteria documented (even if rollback not used)

For sign-off: I’d keep it simple and consistent:
- Pre-rotation approval: Security + Platform owner (so it’s not “security approves in a vacuum”)
- Post-rotation completion: on-call/SRE acknowledgement (or the owning team) + Security sign-off that evidence is complete

Also: can we add a short “customer responsibilities vs Redwood responsibilities” section? Private customers ask who does what.

Naomi
Product (Security & Compliance)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 11:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Rotation evidence template + approvals (KMS) — need alignment + publish deadline

Agree with Naomi’s list.

Two additions from a “make this operable” lens:

1) Separate sign-offs for *policy* vs *execution*.
- Policy/standard ownership: Security (Marcus) proposes the standard; CISO final approves.
- Execution approvals should be a designated “rotation approver” (platform/control plane owner) + “operational readiness” (SRE). Otherwise we’ll block rotations during on-call load.

2) For Private deployments: we should explicitly allow customer-operated rotations (depending on their setup). In that case our template should include a field for “Customer operator sign-off” + “Redwood review (optional)” rather than forcing Redwood to approve something we didn’t execute.

Deadline: publishing by Fri is doable if we freeze content by Wed EOD and do one review pass Thurs.

Priya
VP Platform

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 1:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Rotation evidence template + approvals (KMS) — need alignment + publish deadline

This is helpful. Proposed “minimum required evidence” (v1) based on your notes + what auditors typically look for:

Evidence checklist (v1):
- Scope & identifiers
  - System/component, environment (prod/staging), region(s)
  - Key identifiers (ARN/URI) + key version(s) old/new
  - Rotation type: KEK/DEK (or “envelope key”) + whether dual-read/dual-decrypt applies
- Approvals
  - Pre-rotation approval: Security Engineering lead (named) + owning engineering lead (Control Plane/Private) + SRE readiness acknowledgement
  - Post-rotation completion: execution owner + Security completeness sign-off
- Execution record
  - Planned start/end vs actual
  - Links to automation output / runbook steps executed (command output allowed as pasted text)
  - Any exceptions invoked (and link to exception approval doc)
- Verification
  - Health dashboard snapshot (KMS error rates/latency), plus “no elevated decrypt failures” confirmation
  - Audit log events: key version update / cutover toggles / rotation-related config changes
  - Rollback readiness: rollback criteria + whether rollback was exercised (yes/no)

Sign-offs (proposal):
- Pre-rotation: Security Eng lead + Platform/Control Plane lead + SRE (can be a named on-call or readiness reviewer)
- Post-rotation: Execution owner + Security completeness reviewer
- Private (customer-run): Customer operator sign-off required; Redwood review optional unless contract/SLA requires it

Naomi — we’ll add a “Responsibilities matrix” section. Also we should explicitly reference the exception process doc so teams don’t invent one-off approvals.

If you’re both aligned, I’ll ask Olga/Daniel (GRC) to sanity-check wording, but we’ll keep the approver list stable and not introduce new bureaucracy.

Aisha

Aligned.

One practical request: can we publish two “surfaces” explicitly?
1) Internal runbook + evidence template (operator-focused)
2) Customer-facing page that says what we do, what we can provide, and what we expect from them in Private

Sales/SE keep forwarding internal screenshots right now; we should give them a clean link.

If you want, I can add a short FAQ snippet for common questions:
- “How often do you rotate?”
- “What happens if KMS is down during rotation?”
- “Do you support dual-read?”

Naomi

Good. Let’s do it in two layers as you suggest.

Plan + deadlines:
- By Wed (11/5) EOD: freeze v1 evidence checklist + approval chain (I’ll update the attached template and push to ENG-4826)
- Thu (11/6) noon: Priya review for operational realism (especially Private/customer-run variants)
- Thu (11/6) EOD: Naomi review for customer-facing clarity + responsibilities matrix / FAQ blurb
- Fri (11/7): publish
  - Internal: Confluence runbook + evidence template + exception link
  - External/customer-facing: docs page referencing “what evidence Redwood can provide” + pointers to audit log exports

I’ll also ask that we include a simple “evidence artifact naming” convention so exports can be found later (e.g., KMS_ROTATION_<env>_<system>_<YYYYMMDD>).

Naomi — please draft the FAQ snippet and send back inline; I’ll keep it short and non-committal (no promises beyond what we can execute).

Priya — if you disagree with the SRE sign-off requirement, flag it now; I’d rather relax it for non-prod than ship something we can’t adhere to.

Thanks,
Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
CISO, Redwood Inference
